reasoning: The claim is true. Research published by Katz, Bommarito, et al. (2023) demonstrated that OpenAI's GPT-4 passed the Uniform Bar Examination (UBE) with a score of 298 out of 400. This score comfortably exceeds the passing threshold in all US jurisdictions (which ranges from 260 to 270) and places the model in approximately the 90th percentile of test-takers, performing well above the average human examinee score.
